analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift head lines 1–1043 and supplied patch orientation against the indexed threat model and detailed T-041. Visible changes replace autopilotAllowsModel with autopilotServesModel at line 207 and begin global/per-model loading generations at lines 397 and 434. The guard retains the explicit current-command/load-model exception and subsequent ownership checks. No independently supported security regression is established by these changes.
Surrounding code preserves memory admission, cancellation checks, serialized loading and survivor-grant cleanup. Artifact identity is freshly checked around reusable SSD loads (lines 558–561, 627–637); missing hashes disable reusable caching and remove stale registration state, while mismatches abort before slot installation. Artifact/cache identities reach both engine construction and the resident slot (lines 774–775, 960–961), relevant to T-012, T-027 and T-041. No visible change affects encryption, account cache scoping, attestation permission, credentials, billing or plaintext exposure; existing hash limitations are not new findings.
Integration must reconcile autopilotServesModel and placement lifecycle implementations with the changed admission guard, including command-authorized loads and requests suspended during placement removal. The patch also adds reconcileAutopilotPlacements after residency removal at head lines 1166–1168, outside the numbered excerpts. Verify transitionGenerations consumers and completion/invalidation semantics across successful, failed and special native loads; their implementations are not supplied here. The patch tail covering additional changes near lines 1316–1324 is truncated, so those changes remain a coverage limit rather than evidence of safety. These PR-specific cross-file contracts require the next review pass.
